protocol.question: Does four-lane AVX2 QWORD gather with constrained p-loop unrolling reduce the current IQ2_S NT1 GU producer cost on Zen3?
protocol.mechanism: Original pair producer is unchanged. Private candidate changes grid-load construction,p-loop unroll(full) to unroll(disable),and private symbols,using the same1024-entry8192-byte ggml table. This is a combined lookup/scheduling change;any gain cannot be attributed to gather alone. Integer/FP operation order and storage remain unchanged;no expanded LUT or weight conversion.
protocol.scope: Kernel-only actual iq2_pair_gu_rows versus private candidate,including identical guards,SiLU and output store. Single pinned physical computing core;no production dispatcher,pool,Down or NT2-4. This isolates lookup lowering before any proposed decode-only integration.
protocol.inputs: Two actual22/20 and22/42 format layers,168 experts each,H2560/FF640. Same four deterministic quantized activation rows. Reuse first6 shuffled experts versus stream168;GU active footprints6297600/176332800B are logical,not physical RAM traffic. Full fixture loading outside timing.
protocol.codegen_gate: Before execution:original pair_dot has zero gathers;private gather_pair_dot has2 VPGATHERDQ instructions in the p-loop body (eight p iterations per256-weight block),no calls and no vector stack accesses. Static counts do not prove dynamic uops or speed. A failed lowering screen permits no timing trial.
protocol.numerical: Both arms independently match existing iq256_single_gu_rows output bits for every row/expert;finite outputs,partial/empty/tail rows,rejected metadata/null/alignment/extent,canaries and immutable inputs. Complete860160-byte final captures must match in two check and all six timing processes.
protocol.timing: Six separate owned processes A/B/B/A/A/B;each both format layers and reuse/stream cells. Eight warm passes,then one timer-reference pass. Five full-pass batches>=1s per cell;timer probe outside samples and<0.1% warm pass. No added repetitions or retries after results.
protocol.performance_gate: Per Down format independently:geometric mean of six process-pair/access candidate/reference median latency ratios<=0.97,every ratio<=1.02 and each of three process-pair geomeans<=1.0. No aggregate gain hides a failed format. Passing permits a separate production-pool plan,not model adoption.
protocol.safety: CPU-only static GGML build;reject GPU runtime linkage. Preserve exact6e40 engine+12fixtures at original paths. No process environment mutation or model dispatch change.
protocol.stop: Close first source,ownership,lowering,numerical,capture,timing or work failure without automatic retry. Preserve original outcome.
